_readme: Listings for The plan → Suggestions: real events only, no itinerary. Grouped by date (multi-day items under their first date, or today once they're running). Photos: the item's own Commons photo (image + imageKind) or its ref place's photo. Items disappear after their last day.

items.title: Restaurant Week
items.blurb: Fixed-price set menus all over town, Michelin places included. The good tables go fast, so book any group dinner now.

items.title: Pavilon closing party
items.where: Nehru part, by Petőfi Bridge (Pest side)
items.blurb: The riverside bar's three-day send-off. Friday: DJ Boka, Oliver SCH and Jolán. Saturday: Lutum, Paebo and Kornwall. Daytime into night.
items.check: It has had a 'last night' before, so check their socials first.

items.title: André Rieu
items.blurb: The waltz king and his orchestra in Budapest's new arena. Wildcard entry for the lads, but a serious spectacle.

items.title: Premier League in the pub
items.blurb: Saturday's 3pm UK games kick off at 16:00 here. Champs shows the lot and is a short walk from the Airbnb; book a table for ten.

items.title: Újpest v Puskás Akadémia
items.blurb: The only top-flight game in Budapest this weekend. Purple-and-white noise in an old-school bowl, M3 to Újpest-központ.
items.check: Listings disagree on kick-off (14:00, 17:00 or 19:30), so check ujpestfc.hu. Tickets are in your name: bring a passport.

items.title: Sparty at Széchenyi
items.blurb: Lasers, DJs and drinks in the thermal pools. Pricey, touristy, and a story you'll tell for years.
items.check: Book ahead: it sells out on busy weekends.

items.title: Danko Jones
items.where: A38 Ship, Buda end of Petőfi Bridge
items.blurb: The Canadian riff merchant brings sweaty, no-nonsense hard rock to a 400-capacity boat. Small room, big choruses. About 14,400 HUF.

items.title: Ferencváros v Viktoria Plzeň
items.where: Groupama Aréna, Üllői út, District IX
items.blurb: Europa League night at Fradi's bear pit. Loud, smoky and hostile in the best way.
items.check: Tickets need a Fradi fan card (about 2,000 HUF), collected in person at the stadium.

items.when: Thu 15 Oct · 22:00 till late (also Fri and Sat)
items.title: Robot Rock disco
items.blurb: Free rock disco at Budapest's biggest ruin-bar complex, a seven-minute walk from the Airbnb. Runs till 05:00.

items.title: FTC-Telekom v Pioneers Vorarlberg
items.where: Tüskecsarnok, Buda end of Rákóczi Bridge
items.blurb: Fradi's ice hockey side host the Austrians in the ICE League. Cheap, fast and fiery: about 3,775 HUF.

items.title: The Prowlers + Turbulencer
items.blurb: Veteran Hungarian punk in a grimy basement rock bar a short walk from the Airbnb. Cheap pints, loud guitars.
items.check: Listed by the venue's ticket page; confirm on the night.

items.title: Dub Pistols + Freestylers
items.where: A38 Ship, Buda end of Petőfi Bridge
items.blurb: Two UK big-beat heavyweights on one bill: ska-punk breaks, then the Freestylers. From 9,900 HUF.

items.title: Yung Singh + Ryota
items.blurb: Late one under Erzsébet tér: London's Yung Singh mashes UK garage, jungle and bass, with Osaka's Ryota.

items.title: Sear Bliss
items.where: A38 Ship, Buda end of Petőfi Bridge
items.blurb: Hungary's symphonic black-metal veterans play Phantoms in full for its 30th birthday. One for the metalheads. About 4,500 HUF.

items.when: Sat 17 Oct · doors 18:30, Bikini on about 21:30
items.title: Bikini
items.where: Barba Negra, Csepel (about 25 min by taxi)
items.blurb: Hungarian rock legends since the 80s open their club season. Huge singalong crowd. 6,999 HUF.

items.title: English stand-up: Love & Heartbreaks
items.where: Mixát Udvar, Krúdy utca 7, District VIII
items.blurb: English-language stand-up from the Hot Paprika crew. 3,000 HUF on the door.
items.check: One listing mentions a rooftop instead, so check the venue.

items.when: Sat 17 Oct · start time not listed
items.title: Guns N' Roses + Metallica tributes
items.where: Stenk, Kerepesi út 9, next to Arena Mall (by Keleti)
items.blurb: Double tribute bill: Appetite-era Gunners then Metallica bangers. Pure pints-in-the-air stuff.
